sections.title: 🌍 Global News

sections.title: 🇨🇭 Schweiz

sections.title: 🏡 Regensdorf & Watt
sections.brief: News on Regensdorf (incl. Watt, Adlikon, Affoltern-region neighbours): Gemeinde regensdorf.ch, Limmattaler/Furttaler, Zürcher Unterländer, Tages-Anzeiger. If thin, include relevant Furttal news.

sections.title: 📅 Events Regensdorf & Watt (next 3 months)
sections.brief: Concrete upcoming events in Regensdorf and Watt in the next 3 months from today: check regensdorf.ch, Furttal event calendars, local clubs, Kulturhaus/Zentrum Regensdorf. Title = event name; summary must include date, time and place. Pick the 5 soonest/most notable.

sections.title: ♠️ Poker
sections.brief: Biggest poker news: WSOP, EPT, PokerNews, PokerStars, GGPoker, Card Player, PokerOrg, notable results, rule/industry news.

sections.title: 🤖 AI & OpenClaw

sections.title: 🎬 Movies & Rumors

sections.title: ⚡ Axpo
